name: Chezmoi Hound
author: Enis Budancamanak
description: Dotfile drift in two columns, chezmoi and Claude (~/.claude), each with one Sync button that captures local edits, commits, pulls with rebase, pushes and applies what came in for that side only. The bar shows one sync icon only while something is out of sync.

barWidget.description: Sync icon while dotfiles drift; the panel splits chezmoi and Claude and syncs each side with one button.
